paper_title: Direct Search for Dark Matter Axions Excluding ALP Cogenesis in the 63-67 micro-eV Range, with The ORGAN Experiment
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 as plotted on y-axis
notes: ORGAN Phase 1a haloscope search (UWA, 11.5 T, TM010 cavity, 15.28-16.23 GHz). New 95% CL exclusion g_agamma >= 3e-12 GeV^-1 over 63.2-67.1 ueV, excluding ALP cogenesis in this range. Detailed bin-by-bin limits shown in Fig. 4 but no numerical table available; extracted the headline flat limit from abstract/text as a two-point span. Gaps exist in the exclusion (mode-mixing regions 15.58-15.61, 15.65-15.69, 15.96-16.15 GHz). Assumes axions constitute total local DM density of 0.45 GeV/cm^3 with Maxwell-Boltzmann lineshape (v0=220 km/s).
